leadText:
----
 
Pokémon: Happy Birthday to You! is a one-minute music video that was available to watch on Netflix from September 14, 2017 to September 13, 2021. It features the cast singing a rendition of , accompanied by clips from Pokémon the Series: XY and two clips from Pokémon the Series: Black & White.

It was released as part of Birthdays On-Demand, which included 14 other videos featuring characters from , , , , , , , , , , , , , and . It was released outside of Asia with English, German, French, Italian, European Spanish, Latin American Spanish, Czech, Danish, Greek, Finnish, Hebrew, Dutch, Norwegian, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, European Portuguese, Russian, Swedish, and Turkish audio and subtitles.
